card.name: "May" after "renal function" in RAAS warnings
card.fires_on: The word "may" right after "patients whose renal function" in warnings about drugs that block the renin-angiotensin system. It comes just before "depend on the activity of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system".

modes.label: Renal function may depend
modes.description: "may" follows "In patients whose renal function" in the renal impairment warning of RAAS-blocking drug labels.
modes.example: In patients whose renal function<< may>> depend on the activity of the renin

card.plain: It fires on the word "may" in the standard kidney warning that says some patients' kidney function may depend on the renin-angiotensin system.
